# Snippets

<!-- Generated by `npm run build` from snippets/packs. Edit the packs, not this file. -->

FTC Core offers code snippets while you type in a Java file. Start typing a prefix such as `ftc_teleop` or
`pedro_teleop` and pick the snippet from the completion list, or run **FTC: Insert Snippet** to browse them.
FTC Core adds the imports a snippet needs. Whole-file snippets (OpModes, subsystems) take the package and the
class name from the file.

Which snippets you see depends on the project. FTC Core reads the project's dependencies, so a Pedro Pathing
project gets the Pedro snippets and no Road Runner ones, and a SolversLib project gets SolversLib's commands
and not NextFTC's. Projects with no libraries get the FTC SDK snippets only.

Every prefix starts with the name of its library, so typing `pedro` lists all of that library's snippets. Turn snippets off with the `ftc.snippets.enabled` setting.

FTC Core downloads the latest snippets from this repository once a day, so a change merged here reaches
everyone without an extension update. If a snippet is wrong or missing for a library version, open an issue
or send a pull request. [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#snippets) explains how.

## FTC SDK

OpModes, motors, drive code, the IMU, sensors and AprilTag setup from the FTC SDK.

Offered for: Every FTC project.

| Prefix | Inserts |
| --- | --- |
| `ftc_apriltag` | Start the AprilTag processor on a webcam. |
| `ftc_arcade` | Drive with one stick for speed and one for turning. |
| `ftc_auto` | An Autonomous OpMode that runs in one runOpMode method. |
| `ftc_auto_iterative` | An Autonomous OpMode with init, start, loop and stop methods. |
| `ftc_bulk` | Cache hub reads so each loop talks to the hubs less. In MANUAL mode, clear the cache at the top of every loop. |
| `ftc_color` | Read a color sensor as red, green, blue and alpha, and as hue, saturation and value. |
| `ftc_digital` | Read a digital input. REV touch sensors read false when pressed. |
| `ftc_imu` | Get the built-in IMU and set the hub's orientation on the robot. |
| `ftc_imu_telemetry` | Show yaw, pitch, roll and turn rates. |
| `ftc_mecanum` | Drive a mecanum robot from the left stick and right stick x. |
| `ftc_mecanum_field` | Field-centric mecanum drive using the IMU heading. |
| `ftc_mecanum_setup` | Get four drive motors and set the direction of each side. |
| `ftc_mechanism` | A class that gets its hardware from the HardwareMap in an init method. |
| `ftc_motor` | Declare a motor and get it from the hardware map. |
| `ftc_run_to_position` | Move a motor to an encoder target and wait for it. |
| `ftc_teleop` | A TeleOp OpMode that runs in one runOpMode method. |
| `ftc_teleop_iterative` | A TeleOp OpMode with init, start, loop and stop methods. |
| `ftc_turn_to_heading` | Turn in place to a heading with simple proportional control. |

## FTC SDK vision (12.0+)

Reading AprilTag detections in SDK 12.0 and newer.

Offered for: FTC SDK 12.0 and newer (AprilTag detections changed in 12.0).

| Prefix | Inserts |
| --- | --- |
| `ftc_apriltag_find` | Look for one tag ID in the current detections. |
| `ftc_apriltag_telemetry` | Show each detected tag's ID and position. |

## FTC SDK vision (before 12.0)

Reading AprilTag detections before SDK 12.0.

Offered for: FTC SDK before 12.0.

| Prefix | Inserts |
| --- | --- |
| `ftc_apriltag_find` | Look for one tag ID in the current detections. |
| `ftc_apriltag_telemetry` | Show each detected tag's ID and position. |

## goBILDA Pinpoint

The goBILDA Pinpoint odometry computer built into the FTC SDK.

Offered for: FTC SDK 10.3 and newer, where the Pinpoint driver is built in.

| Prefix | Inserts |
| --- | --- |
| `pinpoint_init` | Get the goBILDA Pinpoint and configure its pod offsets, encoders and starting pose. |
| `pinpoint_update` | Update the Pinpoint once per loop and read the robot's pose. |

## FTC Dashboard

FTC Dashboard: configurable variables, telemetry packets and field drawing.

Offered for: FTC Dashboard or its Sloth build.

| Prefix | Inserts |
| --- | --- |
| `dash_config` | A class whose public static fields can be edited live on the dashboard. |
| `dash_packet` | Send a value and a circle on the field view in one telemetry packet. |

## Ivy

Ivy: Pedro Pathing's command-based library. Autonomous OpModes, path commands, groups and custom commands.

Offered for: Ivy 1.1.0 or newer (`com.pedropathing.ivy:pedro`) with Pedro Pathing 3. The OpMode snippets assume the quickstart's `Constants` class.

| Prefix | Inserts |
| --- | --- |
| `ivy_auto` | An Autonomous OpMode that runs a sequence of Ivy commands: follow a path, wait, act, follow another path. |
| `ivy_command` | A command built from start, execute, done and end callbacks that claims a subsystem while it runs. |
| `ivy_follow` | Schedule a command that follows a path and finishes when the follower reaches its end. |
| `ivy_sequence` | Run commands one after another: follow a path, wait, run an action, follow the next path. |

## NextFTC

NextFTC 1: OpModes, subsystems, commands, mecanum driving and control.

Offered for: NextFTC 1.0 or newer (`dev.nextftc`).

| Prefix | Inserts |
| --- | --- |
| `nextftc_auto` | An Autonomous OpMode that schedules a sequence when Start is pressed. |
| `nextftc_command` | A command class with start, update, stop and isDone. |
| `nextftc_control_system` | A control system with a position PID. |
| `nextftc_mecanum` | Drive a mecanum robot from the left stick and right stick x. |
| `nextftc_subsystem` | A subsystem as a singleton. initialize runs at init and periodic every loop. |
| `nextftc_teleop` | A TeleOp OpMode with the components most teams use. |

## Pedro Pathing

Pedro Pathing 3: OpModes, following paths and manual driving.

Offered for: Pedro Pathing 3.0 or newer (`com.pedropathing:core` or `revhub`). Pedro 2 projects get no Pedro snippets, because the API changed. The OpMode snippets assume the quickstart's `Constants` class.

| Prefix | Inserts |
| --- | --- |
| `pedro_auto` | An Autonomous OpMode that follows a chain of paths with a state machine. |
| `pedro_follow_wait` | Follow a path and wait for it to finish. |
| `pedro_manual_field` | Drive by hand, relative to the field. |
| `pedro_teleop` | A TeleOp OpMode that drives with the Pedro follower, field-centric. |

## Road Runner

Road Runner 1.0: trajectories, actions and the TeleOp drive.

Offered for: Road Runner 1.0 (`com.acmerobotics.roadrunner`). The OpMode snippet assumes the quickstart's `MecanumDrive`.

| Prefix | Inserts |
| --- | --- |
| `rr_action` | A custom Action. run returns true while it should keep running. |
| `rr_action_loop` | Run actions you keep in a list, one tick per loop, with dashboard telemetry. |
| `rr_auto` | An Autonomous that builds a trajectory action and runs it. |
| `rr_teleop_drive` | Drive from the gamepad and update the pose estimate. |

## SolversLib

SolversLib: command-based OpModes, subsystems, commands, motors and PIDF control.

Offered for: SolversLib (`org.solverslib`).

| Prefix | Inserts |
| --- | --- |
| `solvers_auto` | An Autonomous that schedules a sequence of commands. |
| `solvers_command` | A command class with initialize, execute, isFinished and end. |
| `solvers_mecanum_field` | Drive relative to the field. The heading is in degrees. |
| `solvers_motor` | A Motor with a RawPower run mode. |
| `solvers_motor_position` | Move a motor to an encoder position. |
| `solvers_pidf` | Drive a motor toward a target with a PIDF controller until it arrives. |
| `solvers_subsystem` | A subsystem class. periodic() runs every loop. |
| `solvers_telemetry` | Collect telemetry and send it in one call. |
| `solvers_teleop` | A TeleOp that runs the command scheduler. |
| `solvers_timer` | A timer that reports when it's done. |

## SolversLib + Pedro Pathing

SolversLib commands that drive Pedro Pathing 3 paths.

Offered for: SolversLib's Pedro module, version 0.3.6 or newer (Pedro Pathing 3). The OpMode snippets assume the Pedro quickstart's `Constants` class.

| Prefix | Inserts |
| --- | --- |
| `solvers_pedro_auto` | An Autonomous that follows Pedro paths with SolversLib commands. |
| `solvers_pedro_teleop` | A TeleOp that drives the Pedro follower, field-centric. |

## TurtleTracerLib

TurtleTracerLib: reading Turtle Tracer .turt files and triggering actions along a Pedro path.

Offered for: TurtleTracerLib 3.0.0 or newer with Pedro Pathing 3. Put .turt files in `src/main/assets/AutoPaths` of the TeamCode module. The OpMode snippets assume the quickstart's `Constants` class.

| Prefix | Inserts |
| --- | --- |
| `turtle_auto` | An Autonomous OpMode that reads its poses from a .turt file, follows a path and runs an action part-way along it. |
| `turtle_events` | Run actions part-way along a path, after a delay, or when the robot gets near a pose. |
| `turtle_reader` | Load a .turt file from the AutoPaths assets folder and read a pose from it. |
